@concat('"SELECT 
            DISTINCT BLBL.BLEI_CK, BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT, BLBL.BLBL_END_DT, BLBL.BLBL_CREATE_DTM, BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT, BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT, BLBL.BLBL_PAID_STS,
            BLBL.BLBL_DAYS_BILLED, BLBL.BLBL_SPCL_BL_IND, BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST, BLBL.BLBL_TYPE
        FROM 
            FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR    
            JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK
            JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI 
                on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK 
                and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = ''I''    
                AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> ''D''
            JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL 
                on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK    
                AND (BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT < >BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT OR BLBL.BLBL_SPCL_BL_IND IN (''F'',''C''))
            JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV 
                on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID
        WHERE  EXISTS (
    SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_WRITEOFF_LOOKUP LKP
    WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID
) AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT >= TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('gv_BLBLDUEDT')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'')
        AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT <= TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('gv_BatchDate')), '"'',''mm/dd/yyyy'') 
AND EXTRACT( DAY FROM TO_DATE(''"', string(variables('gv_BatchDate')), ''',''mm/dd/yyyy'') ) = 15')

@concat('"SELECT * FROM (SELECT MEPE.MEME_CK, MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT,  MEPE.GRGR_CK, MEPE.CSPI_ID,

LEFT JOIN Facets.CMC_PLDS_PLAN_DESC PLDS ON MEPE.CSPI_ID = PLDS.CSPI_ID  WHERE  EXISTS 
(
    SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_WRITEOFF_LOOKUP LKP

and BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT <BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT
and BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> ''D'') WHERE RN = 1

@concat('"SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM(SELECT  SBSB.SBSB_ID,   MEPE.MEME_CK, MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT, MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT, MEPE.MEPE_CREATE_DTM, MEPE.MEPE_PLAN_ENTRY_DT, BLEI.BLEI_CK, MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND, row_number() over (partition by mepe.meme_ck order by mepe_term_dt desc) as sdf FROM CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB
			JOIN CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI 
			on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = ''I''
			JOIN CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL

			JOIN CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF

       where MEPE_TERM_DT <> ''31-dec-2199''

			JOIN CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI 
			on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = ''I''
			JOIN CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL
			ON  BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK
			JOIN CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID				
			JOIN CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF

        JOIN CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK

gv_MEPEQuery.value: 'SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM(SELECT  SBSB.SBSB_ID,   MEPE.MEME_CK, MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT, MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT, MEPE.MEPE_CREATE_DTM, MEPE.MEPE_PLAN_ENTRY_DT, BLEI.BLEI_CK, MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND, row_number() over (partition by mepe.meme_ck order by mepe_term_dt desc) as sdf FROM CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB 			JOIN CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI  			on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' 			JOIN CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL 			ON  BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK 			JOIN CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID				 			JOIN CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF  				ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK         JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK         JOIN CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK 				AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT AND  MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y')         where sdf = 1)        where MEPE_TERM_DT <> '31-dec-2199'   AND EXTRACT( DAY FROM TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy') ) = 15       UNION SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM(SELECT  SBSB.SBSB_ID,   MEPE.MEME_CK, MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT, MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT, MEPE.MEPE_CREATE_DTM, MEPE.MEPE_PLAN_ENTRY_DT, BLEI.BLEI_CK, MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND, row_number() over (partition by mepe.meme_ck order by mepe_term_dt desc) as sdf FROM CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB 			JOIN CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI  			on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' 			JOIN CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL 			ON  BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK 			JOIN CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID				 			JOIN CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF  				ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK         JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK         JOIN CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK 				AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT AND  MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'N' )         where sdf = 1)        where MEPE_TERM_DT = '31-dec-2199'  AND EXTRACT( DAY FROM TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy') ) = 15 '

gv_BLBLQuery2.value: 'SELECT              DISTINCT BLBL.BLEI_CK, BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT, BLBL.BLBL_END_DT, BLBL.BLBL_CREATE_DTM, BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT, BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT, BLBL.BLBL_PAID_STS,             BLBL.BLBL_DAYS_BILLED, BLBL.BLBL_SPCL_BL_IND, BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST, BLBL.BLBL_TYPE          FROM              FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR                 JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK             JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI                  on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK                  and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'                     AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'             JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL                  on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK                     AND (BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT <BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT OR BLBL.BLBL_SPCL_BL_IND IN ('F','C'))             JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV                  on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID        WHERE  EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_WRITEOFF_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID ) AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT >=  TO_DATE('1/1/2015','mm/dd/yyyy') AND                  BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT <= TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy')  AND EXTRACT( DAY FROM TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy') ) = 15 '

gv_BLBLQuery.value: 'SELECT              DISTINCT BLBL.BLEI_CK, BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT, BLBL.BLBL_END_DT, BLBL.BLBL_CREATE_DTM, BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT, BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT, BLBL.BLBL_PAID_STS,             BLBL.BLBL_DAYS_BILLED, BLBL.BLBL_SPCL_BL_IND, BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST, BLBL.BLBL_TYPE         FROM              FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR                 JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK             JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI                  on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK                  and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'                     AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'             JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL                  on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK                     AND (BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT < >BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT OR BLBL.BLBL_SPCL_BL_IND IN ('F','C'))             JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV                  on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID         WHERE  EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_WRITEOFF_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID ) AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT >= TO_DATE('1/1/2015','mm/dd/yyyy')         AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT <= TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy')  AND EXTRACT( DAY FROM TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy') ) = 15'

gv_BGBGQuery.value: 'SELECT BGBG.BGBG_CK, BGBG.BGBG_ID, BGBG.CICI_ID, BGBG.BGBG_NAME, BGBG.BGBG_ADDR1, BGBG.BGBG_ADDR2, BGBG.BGBG_ADDR3, BGBG.BGBG_CITY, BGBG.BGBG_STATE, BGBG.BGBG_ZIP, BGBG.BGBG_COUNTY, BGBG.BGBG_CTRY_CD, BGBG.BGBG_MCTR_TYPE, BGBG.BGBG_ORIG_EFF_DT, BGBG.BGBG_TERM_DT, BGBG.BGBG_SPLT_BILL_IND FROM FACETS.CMC_BGBG_BIL_GROUP BGBG WHERE BGBG_ID NOT LIKE 'W%' AND EXTRACT( DAY FROM TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy') ) = 15'

gv_MEPEQuery.value: 'SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM(SELECT  SBSB.SBSB_ID,   MEPE.MEME_CK, MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT, MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT, MEPE.MEPE_CREATE_DTM, MEPE.MEPE_PLAN_ENTRY_DT, BLEI.BLEI_CK, MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND, row_number() over (partition by mepe.meme_ck order by mepe_term_dt desc) as sdf FROM CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB 			JOIN CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI  			on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' 			JOIN CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL 			ON  BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK 			JOIN CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID				 			JOIN CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF  				ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK         JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK         JOIN CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK 				AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT AND  MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'Y')         where sdf = 1)        where MEPE_TERM_DT <> '31-dec-2199'   AND EXTRACT( DAY FROM TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy') ) = 15       UNION SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM(SELECT  SBSB.SBSB_ID,   MEPE.MEME_CK, MEPE.MEPE_EFF_DT, MEPE.MEPE_TERM_DT, MEPE.MEPE_CREATE_DTM, MEPE.MEPE_PLAN_ENTRY_DT, BLEI.BLEI_CK, MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND, row_number() over (partition by mepe.meme_ck order by mepe_term_dt desc) as sdf FROM CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB 			JOIN CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI  			on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I' 			JOIN CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL 			ON  BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK 			JOIN CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV ON BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID				 			JOIN CMC_BLDF_BL_DEFINE BLDF  				ON BLDF.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK         JOIN CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK         JOIN CMC_MEPE_PRCS_ELIG MEPE ON MEPE.MEME_CK = MEME.MEME_CK 				AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT BETWEEN BLDF.BLDF_EFF_DT AND BLDF.BLDF_TERM_DT AND  MEPE.MEPE_ELIG_IND = 'N' )         where sdf = 1)        where MEPE_TERM_DT = '31-dec-2199'  AND EXTRACT( DAY FROM TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy') ) = 15 '

gv_populatewriteoffrptquery.value: 'SELECT BatchDate, RunDate, LastName, FirstName, MI, HCID, GroupID, ClassID, ContractID, PBP, PlanName, PlanType, CoverageType, OSBIndicator,  WriteOffReason, LastDue, TotalAmount, (CASE WHEN PPAInd = 1 THEN 'YES' ELSE 'NO' END) AS PPAInd FROM WriteOff.WriteOff WHERE BatchID = 7'

gv_MEMEQuery.value: 'select DISTINCT MEME.MEME_CK, MEME.GRGR_CK, MEME.SBSB_CK, MEME.MEME_LAST_NAME, MEME.MEME_FIRST_NAME, MEME.MEME_MID_INIT, MEME.MEME_ORIG_EFF_DT, MEME.MEME_SEX, MEME.MEME_BIRTH_DT, MEME.MEME_HICN, MEME.MEME_ELIG_DT, MEME.SYS_LAST_UPD_DTM FROM FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK	 Join FACETS.CMC_MEME_MEMBER MEME ON MEME.SBSB_CK = SBSB.SBSB_CK JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI on SBSB.SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK	 JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID	 WHERE  EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_WRITEOFF_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID )  and BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT <BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT and BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'  and MEME.MEME_SFX = 0  AND EXTRACT( DAY FROM TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy') ) = 15 '

gv_BLEIQuery.value: '                      SELECT      DISTINCT BLEI.BLEI_CK, BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL, BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK, BLEI.BLEI_NET_DUE, BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_DUE_DT, BLEI.BLEI_LST_BL_END_DT,     BLEI.BLEI_LAST_BILL_DTM, BLEI.BLEI_PCS_STS, BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND, BLEI.BLEI_LST_TL_DUE_DT FROM      FACETS.CMC_GRGR_GROUP GRGR         JOIN FACETS.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB          on GRGR.GRGR_CK = SBSB.GRGR_CK     JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLEI_ENTY_INFO BLEI          on SBSB_CK = BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL_CK          and BLEI.BLEI_BILL_LEVEL = 'I'         AND BLEI.BLEI_SUSPND_BL_IND <> 'D'         JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLBL_BILL_SUMM BLBL          on BLEI.BLEI_CK = BLBL.BLEI_CK           AND BLBL.BLBL_RCVD_AMT < BLBL.BLBL_BILLED_AMT       JOIN FACETS.CMC_BLIV_INVOICE BLIV          on BLBL.BLBL_BLIV_ID_LAST = BLIV.BLIV_ID WHERE  EXISTS (     SELECT * FROM AGP.BOSS_WRITEOFF_LOOKUP LKP     WHERE GRGR.GRGR_ID = LKP.GRGR_ID )  AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT >=  TO_DATE('1/1/2015','mm/dd/yyyy')  AND BLBL.BLBL_DUE_DT <= TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy')  AND EXTRACT( DAY FROM TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy') ) = 15    '

gv_Simplyflorida.value: 'Select 'W' As Receipt_Code,'WOO' As Receipt_Reason,' ' As Payment_Method,' ' as  Vendor_Reference_Id,Sbsb.Sbsb_Id As Subscriber_Id,Grgr.Grgr_Id As Group_Id,' ' As Billing_Group_Id, Blei.Blei_Net_Due As Amount,'SIMPLYWO' As Check_Number,to_char(Sysdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') As Received_Date from Facets.CMC_SBSB_SUBSC SBSB JOIN FACETS.cmc_grgr_group grgr on sbsb.grgr_ck = grgr.grgr_ck and grgr.grgr_id = 'FLMCR000' join facets.cmc_meme_member meme on meme.sbsb_ck = sbsb.sbsb_ck join facets.cmc_mepe_prcs_elig mepe on mepe.meme_ck = meme.meme_ck join facets.cmc_blei_enty_info blei on sbsb.sbsb_ck = blei.blei_bill_level_ck and blei.blei_bill_level = 'I' and sysdate between mepe_eff_dt and mepe_term_dt and mepe_elig_ind = 'Y' And Blei_Net_Due > 0   and Extract(Month from TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy') )  =12 AND EXTRACT( DAY FROM TO_DATE('10/15/2020','mm/dd/yyyy') ) <> 15'
